attempts.summary: Configured node1 (RHEL 7.9, BIOS grub2) to boot with audit=1 persistently by adding it to GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX in /etc/default/grub and applying it to all grub2 kernel entries via `grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args=audit=1`. Rebooted node1 to confirm persistence, verified boot_id changed (real restart), and confirmed /proc/cmdline and the kernel audit subsystem (auditctl -s, dmesg) reflect audit=1 post-reboot.
